title: Gladiator skill and stigma icons
caption: At level 30 the Gladiator's Skills, Stigmas and Next up cards show each skill's game icon instead of a letter square.

title: Spiritmaster icons on the phone
caption: At level 45 on a phone, the Spiritmaster's Next up list shows Cold Shock and Combustion with their game icons.

title: Spiritmaster skill and stigma icons
caption: At level 30 the Spiritmaster's Skills card shows Cold Shock and the Stigmas card Summon: Ancient Spirit with their game icons.
